nodes.speaker: arch
nodes.text: The habitat is up, but the walls are thin. Bury it in soil, or start the greenhouse?

variants.text: The delta gives us free building rocks! Pile them on the roof, or start the greenhouse?
Flat ground made setup easy, but there is no cliff to hide behind. Cover the roof, or start the greenhouse?

nodes.fact: Martian soil, called regolith, can be piled on habitats as radiation shielding, because Mars has very little atmosphere.
